mapper.select: SELECT api_code as apiCode, min(valid_start_date) as validStartDate, max(valid_end_date) as validEndDate FROM b_marketing_customize_data_valid_config WHERE is_del = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d') between valid_start_date and valid_end_date AND (api_code,task_id) IN (SELECT api_code,task_id FROM b_marketing_customize_data_valid_config WHERE id = #{id});
